verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics framework rather than an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The CLI tools, client libraries and the community remark that LLMs handle ROS boilerplate are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
